verdict.rationale: Tailscale markets automating a tailnet, so the axis is fair to ask about. However, the evidence shows only developer building blocks: infrastructure-as-code providers, webhooks, cloud-init installs, and ephemeral nodes for CI. It also shows host-platform hooks (the iOS Shortcuts app) and a user-built Slack-bot workaround. None of these is a first-party capability for configuring automations that run autonomously in the background.
